This chapter follows conserved state through the EOS[^rg-ba9e60e5ab2e] and the final-stage phase solve. It describes the
five EOS types, their energy conventions and the identities required by transport and temperature floors.
Floors belong to @sec-ch08; rejection and condensate repair belong to @sec-ch10.
